closed note 5595337 (near Tanítótelep, Örvényes) / Created 9 days ago by Kornai
17 Vizililiom utca is the building where I placed the mark. This is the 3rd building on the left as you walk up from Grassó Apát utca. This is our building, and we have the letter from Örvényes city council to prove that the street address is #17 Vizililiom. These numbers have only been issued recently, before only cadastral numbers were in use (ours is 169/6). The street numbering follows the ordinary Hungarian pattern: odd numbers on the left, even on the right, growing as you walk down towards the lake. Thank you for fixing this, please do not hesitate to get in contact in case you need further clarification. / Resolved about 17 hours ago by Kecsege
